note: A plan that DECLARES a runtime profile reload inside the boot window (e.g. client-hmr reacting to a profile patch write, or a plugin install). Statically this is the same mechanism class as a composition unwind: the storage-domain fiber is disposed under the detached Team bootstrap.

runtimeReload.why: client-hmr watches profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml and calls reconcileProfilePatches -> entry.update -> Fiber._reload on change
